# 4 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> Build Date: early 70's Approximate Area: TBC THE PROPERTY: This well-presented semi-detached home offers spacious and versatile accommodation, ideal for family living. The ground floor features a front living room which flows through to a kitchen/dining room at the rear, opening directly onto the garden.
